name: Hiru wa Betsu no Kao
source:
After graduating from school, the main character starts to operate an underground Internet site. One day he is offered a Jewish book dating from 1000 years ago. He buys the book and tries to translate it. It suggests to search for naughtiness. It looks ridiculous, but everyday life changes little by little. He starts to exchange emails with four women to learn their identities and train them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
从学校毕业后，主人公开始经营一个地下网站。某天，有人向他兜售一本有着1000年历史的犹太古籍。他买下书并尝试翻译，书中似乎在引导读者追寻淫欲。内容看似荒诞可笑，他的日常生活却开始一点一点发生变化。为了查明四名女性的身份并调教她们，他开始与她们交换电子邮件。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
